description.value:
Transcendent · Vast · Unreachable · Unaware of Any Single Mortal

Not a relationship — a background process at reality-scale. Too vast to summon, petition, or hold a grudge against one person; reached even by its own faithful through liturgy rather than contact. The Reckoner doesn't bargain with it; they draw on the overflow of whatever it's always doing regardless of anyone watching. Thematically tied to entropy, decay, and the half-life of everything — nuclear, mortal, and otherwise. Its Curse isn't punishment; it's what channeling something that scale costs a mortal frame, worsening the more they draw on it. Unlike the thing at the center of a black hole, it isn't reaching for anything — not converts, not other transcendents, not even itself, continuing.
